required_documents.name: DOE Consolidated eXCHANGE Account Setup
required_documents.details: Register and maintain active login on the consolidated DOE eXCHANGE portal (exchange.energy.gov) prior to application.

required_documents.name: PROSPECT Technical Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Technical narrative detailing collaborative educational pathways across the critical minerals and materials value chain (resource extraction, processing, manufacturing, recycling).

required_documents.name: Workforce Training and Curriculum Development Plan
required_documents.details: Comprehensive strategy for developing a durable talent pipeline through higher education, apprenticeships, and specialized workforce development.

required_documents.name: Multi-Sector Partnership Letters of Commitment
required_documents.details: Commitment agreements between academia, industry employers, national laboratories, and regional education partners.

required_documents.name: DOE Detailed Budget Justification Workbook
required_documents.details: Comprehensive project budget allocating direct personnel, equipment, student support, and sub-recipient funding across up to  million total program allocation.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active UEI Registration
required_documents.details: Active Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) registration in SAM.gov for lead institution and key consortium members.

deadlines.what: Anticipated NOFO Release / Application Target Date

eligibility.summary: Unrestricted eligibility. Open to higher education institutions, industry partners, national laboratories, nonprofit training providers, and state/local government entities.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing terms will be formally specified in the full Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) upon release on DOE eXCHANGE.

review_criteria.criterion: Impact on Domestic Critical Minerals Workforce & Talent Pipeline
Strength and Cohesion of Multi-Sector Collaboration (Academia, Industry, National Labs)
Curriculum Feasibility, Scalability, and Industry Value-Chain Alignment

funded_activities.activity: Strengthening educational pathways across the entire critical minerals and materials supply chain (extraction, processing, manufacturing, recycling).
Developing specialized degree tracks, technical certifications, and university/community-college articulation agreements.
Hands-on student research, internships, and apprenticeships embedded with industry and national laboratory partners.

submission_limits: Entities may participate in multiple consortia; primary applicant restrictions will be detailed in the forthcoming full NOFO.
important_notes: This is a Notice of Intent (NOI). Formal application instructions and binding guidelines will be issued in the final NOFO on exchange.energy.gov.
DOE will not respond to questions regarding this NOI prior to NOFO publication.
